name: slack
title: Slack
description: What Slack is holding for you: direct messages, mentions and threads as rows with the message and who sent it, the channels you are in, Slack's search, and your status, presence and Do Not Disturb. Signs in through the desktop app's own session or a user token.
author: pal

settings.label: Sign in
settings.description: app reads the desktop app's own session (its token from Local Storage and its cookie from the cookie jar, decrypted with the Safe Storage password in the keychain), so it sees exactly your inbox; token uses a user token from a Slack app of your own.

settings.label: Token
settings.description: A user token (xoxp-...) with channels:read, groups:read, im:read, mpim:read, channels:history, groups:history, im:history, mpim:history, users:read, chat:write, search:read, users.profile:write, users:write, dnd:write. Only with Sign in set to token.

settings.label: Workspace
settings.description: The workspace to use when the app is signed in to several, by id (T...) or domain (acme for acme.slack.com); empty lists every signed-in one, with status and search on the first.

settings.label: Status presets
settings.description: One per line as :emoji: text (expiry); the expiry is 30m, 2h, 1d or today, or left out for no expiry.

settings.label: Direct messages
settings.text: Draw the bar item as urgent (red) while a direct message is unread

settings.label: Presence dots
settings.text: A dot on each direct message row: green while the person is active, grey while away
settings.description: One users.getPresence per person among the unread direct messages, remembered a minute; off makes no such call, for a workspace where many direct messages are open at once.

settings.label: Refresh
settings.description: Seconds between refreshes of the bar item; it also refreshes when the panel shows, after a wake and when the network is back.

settings.label: Bar item
settings.description: When the Unreads item is drawn. The count is always what is addressed to you; the other choices keep the glyph on the strip, muted and without a badge, while a channel is merely unread or at all times.

options.title: When something is addressed to you
Also while a channel is unread

unreads.title: Unreads
unreads.description: Direct messages, mentions and threads addressed to you, then the channels that are only unread; each row with who said what and how long ago.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Every channel, group and direct message you are in, with the topic and the member count.

search.title: Search Slack
search.description: Slack's message search as you type, its syntax passed through: from:@name, in:#channel, has:link, before:yesterday.

status.title: Status
status.description: Your status, presence and Do Not Disturb as the first rows; set a status from the presets, clear it, snooze notifications for 30 minutes, an hour or until tomorrow, go away or active.

unreads.title: Unreads
unreads.description: What is addressed to you (direct messages, mentions, thread replies) as a count, hidden at zero, red while a direct message waits; the popover lists them with the sender, the message and the time, the channels that are only unread, and replies, marks read and opens from the keys.

channels.title: Only channels unread, kept on the bar (Bar item: unread)

always.title: Nothing unread, kept on the bar (Always)

clear.title: Nothing addressed to you, or signed out

keys.title: Move the cursor (down, j, k too; a click sets it)
Reply: the search row becomes the field, Enter sends
Open the row in the browser

store.tagline: Your Slack inbox, the part that is yours, in the panel and on the bar
features: Unreads: direct messages, mentions and thread replies as rows with the sender's avatar, the message and how long ago; the channels that are merely unread named under them
Enter opens the conversation in the Slack app at the message; Reply is a one-field form that posts from the panel; Mark as read from the row
The bar item counts only what is addressed to you, so it is usually hidden and worth reading when it is not; red while a direct message waits
Channels: every channel, group and direct message you are in, with the topic and the member count
Search Slack as you type with Slack's own syntax: from:@name, in:#channel, has:link
Status: presets with an expiry, clear, Do Not Disturb for 30 minutes, an hour or until tomorrow, away or active
No Slack app to install: the desktop app's own session is read from its files, so what you see is exactly your inbox

actions.title: Open
actions.description: The conversation in the Slack app, at the message when one is known.

actions.title: Reply
actions.description: A one-field form; posts to the conversation (into the thread for a threaded mention).

actions.title: Mark as read
actions.description: Up to the latest message; the count falls at the next refresh.

actions.title: Do Not Disturb
actions.description: 30 minutes, 1 hour, or until tomorrow; End Do Not Disturb while it is on.
